question: Convention on the prohibition of the use of nuclear weapons and reducing nuclear danger under the nuclear weapons cluster were two resolutions sponsored by India that ______ adopted in 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**UN General Assembly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Convention on the prohibition of the use of nuclear weapons and reducing nuclear danger under the nuclear weapons cluster were two resolutions sponsored by India that UN General Assembly adopted in 2020**__.

 __
 
• The first committee of the UNGA looks after disarmament and works in collaboration with the Conference on Disarmament and UN Disarmament Commission.
 
• The two resolutions which have been adopted are titled ‘**Convention on the Prohibition of the Use of Nuclear Weapons**’ and The resolution on "Reducing Nuclear Danger", tabled since 1998, draws global attention to the risks of unintentional or accidental use of nuclear weapons and underscores the need for a review of nuclear doctrines.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The** United Nations General Assembly** is one of the six principal organs of the United Nations, serving as the main deliberative, policymaking, and representative organ of the UN.

 
 
• Its powers, composition, functions, and procedures are set out in Chapter IV of the United Nations Charter.
 
• **President: Abdulla Shahid **
 
• **Headquarters: New York**
